Inline comments:
Review comments at @.github/identity-baseline.txt:
- Around line 1-9: Add a required CI check that reads
.github/identity-baseline.txt and .github/approved-git-identities.txt and
enforces the documented author/committer email and newly added absolute home
path checks; alternatively, wire both files into pm health so the existing
required check enforces them.

Review comments at @.github/workflows/release.yml:
- Line 469: Update the tracking link in the release PR body passed to `--body`
so it points to `.agents/pm/epics/pm-review-epic.toon` and uses the matching
`pm-review-epic` label.

Review comments at @.gitignore:
- Line 10: Remove the `.agents/pm/search/` ignore rule so Git can apply the
existing exception for `eval-queries.json`; retain the `.agents/pm/search/*`
rule that ignores other contents.

Review comments at @scripts/coverage-gate.ts:
- Around line 195-201: Handle a `sources: ["."]` entry in the
source-normalization logic that builds `name` and `include` in the coverage-gate
flow: use "." when the root-relative name is empty, and emit the
repository-relative pattern `**/*.ts` for that name instead of `/**/*.ts`.

Review comments at @src/findings.ts:
- Around line 5-6: Update the actionable-marker check in the body-classification
logic to recognize outside-diff findings and nitpick sections, including their
count headings and severity labels, so those review bodies are not classified as
informational. Preserve the existing markers and the informational fallback.

Review comments at @src/round.ts:
- Line 18: Update the completion fallback in the `isRabbit` check so a reply is
not considered evidence for the current head based on `pr.headDate`, which
reflects the commit time. Use the timestamp when the head became current from
the PR timeline, or remove the fallback and require a review object associated
with the exact head.

Review comments at @src/verdict.ts:
- Line 31: In the apply validation before remote writes, reject `input.verdict
=== 'pending'` with an error explaining that only final verdicts can be applied.
Keep the existing thread-kind and transport checks intact so pending decisions
remain local.

Review comments at @test/github.test.ts:
- Around line 562-568: Update the `stuck` fetch in the “bounds every request
with the configured timeout” test to hold a ref’d handle while awaiting the
abort, then clear that handle in the abort listener before rejecting. This keeps
the event loop alive until the timeout fires without changing production
behavior.

After applying the fix, consider running `coderabbit review --agent` for local
review. Visit https://docs.coderabbit.ai/cli?utm_source=ghpr
```

</details>
